svg.title: Candidate deployment and trust zones
svg.desc: Engineer Windows PCs run browser, Desktop, Web-rendered Workbench, per-user Workspace process and external Office or CAD tools. Reviewer and administrator devices use separate Web entry points. All cross-device calls use HTTPS to a company-managed server zone containing the server, database, private Artifact store and isolated format runtime.
